verdict.rationale: Bruno collections are plain text files that live on the filesystem and integrate natively with Git, giving version control, diff review, and rollback via standard Git operations (init, diff, pull, commit) either through CLI or built-in GUI. However, this is generic Git-based versioning for API collections, not an AI-native 'automation' versioning/rollback system with audit trails or one-click revert of AI-generated changes — it relies on the user manually committing/reviewing via Git. missing for 10: no dedicated rollback UI beyond Git, no automation-specific versioning history distinct from generic file/Git versioning, no evidence of AI-specific audit trail or diff-review workflow tailored to automations.
